### René Descartes on reason

René Descartes (1596–1650) approaches reason within Rationalism. Methodic doubt strips away uncertain beliefs until the cogito—thinking existence—stands firm. Clear and distinct perception, guaranteed by a non-deceiving God, rebuilds knowledge of mind, God, and material nature. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets reason most directly—useful for searches such as “rené descartes quotes on reason.”
